meta.title: A saved eRFX draft: "Savings" opens the "Savings Calculation" window
gaps: Prove that nothing on the event changes before a button in the Savings Calculation window is pressed.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Prove that nothing on the event changes before a button in the Savings Calculation window is pressed.

steps.note: Create the eRFX draft required by the case.
A title is required before saving a draft.
Apply a pricing template so the draft can contain a configured eRFX sheet.
Add a line item so the draft is complete enough to save.
Complete the pricing sheet before saving the draft.
Commit a schedule required for the draft flow.
Add a participant so the draft represents a usable event.
Save the eRFX event as an unpublished draft.
Verify the draft save did not produce an application error.
Navigate to the Events list to locate the saved draft.
Open the Drafts tab specified by the case.
Verify the newly saved draft appears in the Drafts list.
Open this plan's saved draft, returning to its create screen.
Open the Savings control on the saved draft.
Verify that the Savings Calculation window opens.

args.text: How do you want to measure savings?

steps.note: Verify the measurement prompt is shown.
Verify the Gross Total option is offered.
Verify the Line Item option is offered.

args.text: Choose column to calculate savings on

steps.note: Verify the column-selection control is present.
Verify the Add Custom Reference button is present.
Verify the Cancel button is present.
Verify the Save button is present.
